annual.label: Avg yearly maintenance, 5-year average (Recharged, at 15,000 mi/yr, tires extra)

maint.job: Front brake pads (with rotors when needed)
maint.every: Pads often last 60,000–100,000+ miles thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: Pads alone run about $490–$810 per axle; pads and rotors about $650–$1,200 or more.

maint.job: Rear brake pads (with rotors when needed)
maint.every: Pads often last 60,000–100,000+ miles; inspect at each annual service
maint.note: Rotors can rust from light use, which is a common reason to replace them early on EVs.

maint.job: Cooling system flush (battery and electronics loop)
maint.every: Long intervals; check the owner's manual and fix any leak promptly
maint.note: Brake fluid also needs changing about every 2 years.
